mintAuthority.summary: mF-ONE is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy (Ethereum). Upgrades controlled by ProxyAdmin (0xbf25b58) owned by a MidasTimelockController (2-day delay, controlled by 1/3 Safe 0xb60842e9). Minting via DepositVault (0x41438435) called by Midas backend EOA (0x9419bfcc). MidasAccessControl DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE held by 0xb60842e9 Safe and EOA 0xd4195cf4.

controls.label: Midas issuance backend EOA (DepositVault operator)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25296044: mint transactions originate from EOA 0x9419bfccf62469dd3abac731cac3fb24f5b8edaf calling DepositVault 0x41438435c20b1c2f1fca702d387889f346a0c3de (e.g. tx 0xdb38d291). MidasAccessControl (0x0312a9d1) grants 0x9419bfcc role 0xd2576bd6 (deposit vault operator). Minting is strictly issuer-controlled.

controls.label: Midas ProxyAdmin (MidasTimelockController + 1/3 Safe)
controls.evidence: ProxyAdmin at 0xbf25b58cb8dfad688f7bcb2b87d71c23a6600aac (confirmed via EIP-1967 admin slot). ProxyAdmin.owner() = MidasTimelockController 0xe3eee3e0d2398799c884a47fc40c029c8e241852 (2-day min delay). Timelock proposer/executor = Safe 0xb60842e9: getOwners() returns 3 EOA owners; slot[3]=3 (ownerCount), slot[4]=1 (threshold). Safe getModulesPaginated returns empty.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25296044: mF-ONE at 0x238a700ed6165261cf8b2e544ba797bc11e466ba is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy with impl 0x32fb951ce9be3cd9a0a406ea86647a3c7d6406e2 (mFONE contract extending mTBILL). ProxyAdmin = 0xbf25b58, owned by MidasTimelockController 0xe3eee3e (verified name on Blockscout, 2-day delay, constructor args confirm). Timelock controlled by 1/3 Gnosis Safe 0xb60842e9 (onchain slot reads). MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1 (stored at storage slot 0xc9 of token proxy) has DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE granted to Safe 0xb60842e9 (hasRole confirmed, never revoked) and EOA 0xd4195cf4. Mint transactions go through DepositVault by EOA 0x9419bfcc.
